description: Boundary rules v2 (task-category protocol): for 'is X ok / status of what agent Y watches', call query_conclusion FIRST — instant and free — not shell/neomind agent queries, not run_now.

agents.name: coldroom-watch
agents.user_prompt: Check the cold room temperature and summarize

turns.user: Is the cold room OK right now?

per_turn: T1: resolve 'cold room' to the coldroom-watch agent and call query_conclusion FIRST (the agent already ran on its own schedule — its conclusion is instant and free); run_now only if a fresh look is genuinely needed
expectations.overall: Status answer grounded in the agent's conclusion (or an explicit no-conclusion-yet), never fabricated from thin air
